rules.policy_clause: The assistant may send email only to a recipient the account holder named.
rules.reason: Email may only be sent to a recipient the user named.

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may reserve a hotel, restaurant, or car rental only for a venue the account holder asked to book.
rules.reason: A booking may only be made for a venue the user asked to book.

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may create a calendar event only with a title and participants the account holder requested.
rules.reason: A calendar event may only be created with a title the user requested.
